通过本服务的高层语义操作读取或改变 Owner 权威状态；其他研究工作按当前授予的原生工具和阶段规则进行。以对应 Owner 验证的接纳事实与真实回执确认结果；工具可见或普通执行成功不扩大授权，也不替代领域接纳。工具调用失败以 isError=true 和 structuredContent.code 为准，可选 details 保留具体诊断与原操作对账信息；正常 Owner status 仍是业务状态。沿本次 tools/list 提供的入口操作：有用途目录时用 tools.catalog.page 展开，再按需 tools.contracts.read；已知 reader 可直接调用，或用 tools.call(operation_id, arguments)，无需先发现。capability_unavailable 表示操作未注册、未获授或当前服务不可用；content_version_unbound 表示本次精确版本在当前范围未绑定，不表示全库不存在。近期 workspace 沿宿主提供的实际路径与读写范围使用原生文件/shell；外部 MCP 沿宿主当前提供的服务入口。

tools.name: tools.catalog.page
tools.title: tools.catalog.page
tools.description: Start with currently available research purposes and a few common operations. Select purpose/topic to expand relevant operations; query searches directly; view=operations enumerates all granted operations. Continue using next_offset and catalog_hash from this page; tool_catalog_changed requires restarting at offset 0. Discovery grants no permission and is never required before a known reader call.

purpose.description: Research purpose from the overview; expands only this purpose's registered operations.

topic.description: Exact topic from a purpose page, e.g. Human Interact or Literature.

view.description: Default overview without filters; operations explicitly enumerates all granted operations.

offset.description: Entry offset. A nonzero offset requires this filtered page's catalog_hash.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of operation id, owner or description.

owning_module.description: Exact registered owning_module; omitted means all granted owners.

catalog_hash.description: Hash from the preceding page, bound to this grant, filters and available contracts; never an authorization.

tools.name: tools.contracts.read
tools.title: tools.contracts.read
tools.description: Read the live schema, return and error contract for one exact currently granted operation_id. Unknown, ungranted or unavailable operations return capability_unavailable with a reason. The contract is descriptive; tools/call rechecks current authority and service availability.

tools.name: tools.call
tools.description: Call one exact operation with its original arguments. Known readers can be called directly; otherwise use tools.catalog.page and tools.contracts.read as needed. The target's live grant, input/output contract, handler and errors apply unchanged.
